test_cases.test_case: Successful login redirects to Dashboard
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
3. Click the 'Log in' button
test_cases.expected_result: redirects to Dashboard

test_cases.test_case: Access the site as a guest
steps: 1. Click the 'Access as a guest' button
test_cases.expected_result: grants unauthenticated browsing access

test_cases.test_case: Open the cookies notice
steps: 1. Click the 'Cookies notice' button
test_cases.expected_result: displays cookie usage information

test_cases.test_case: Verify 'Lost password?' link is present but disabled on this test site
preconditions: Lost password feature disabled on this test site
steps: 1. Attempt to click the 'Lost password?' link
test_cases.expected_result: 'Lost password?' link is visible and displayed in a disabled state (not clickable)

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Username left blank (text required field representative)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and is not authenticated
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Enter <valid password> in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Username field indicating it is required; the form is not submitted; the user remains on the Login page (no redirect).

test_cases.test_case: Submit with Password left blank (password required field representative)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and is not authenticated
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Password field indicating it is required; the form is not submitted; the user remains on the Login page (no redirect).

test_cases.test_case: Submit with ALL required fields empty
preconditions: User is on the Login page and is not authenticated
steps: 1. Leave the Username field blank
2. Leave the Password field blank
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on the Username and Password fields indicating they are required; the form is not submitted; the user remains on the Login page (no redirect).

test_cases.test_case: Submit with invalid credentials (authentication failure)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and is not authenticated
steps: 1. Enter <valid username> in the Username field
2. Enter <invalid password> in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: An inline error message appears on the form indicating invalid credentials; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains its entered value; the user remains on the Login page (no redirect to Dashboard).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use disabled "Lost password?" link (precondition: feature disabled)
preconditions: User is on the Login page and is not authenticated
The Lost password? feature is disabled on this test site
steps: 1. Observe the "Lost password?" link on the page
2. Click the "Lost password?" link
test_cases.expected_result: The "Lost password?" link is visibly disabled/non-interactive (disabled attribute or visually greyed); clicking it does not navigate or open a password recovery flow; the user remains on the Login page.

test_cases.test_case: Very long Username retained on failed login; Password cleared
steps: 1. Enter <very long string (200+ characters)> in the Username field
2. Enter an incorrect value in the Password field
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked / error shown: an inline error message is shown; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered very long string (exact characters remain visible in the Username input).

test_cases.test_case: Username with leading/trailing whitespace retained after failed login
steps: 1. Enter <username with leading and trailing whitespace> in the Username field
2. Enter an incorrect value in the Password field
3. Click the Log in button
test_cases.expected_result: Login is blocked / error shown: an inline error message is shown; the Password field is cleared; the Username field retains the entered value including the leading and trailing whitespace (visible in the Username input).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click Log in with valid credentials — second submission blocked
steps: 1. Enter a valid Username in the Username field
2. Enter the matching valid Password in the Password field
3. Click the Log in button
4. Immediately click the Log in button a second time
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: user is redirected to the Dashboard. The second submission attempt is blocked: no second navigation or duplicate submission occurs and no additional error is shown; user ends up on the Dashboard (single successful redirect).

test_cases.test_case: Reset page to default while in Edit mode
steps: 1. Toggle Edit Mode on using the Edit Mode control

steps: 1. Observe the Calendar block month view on load

preconditions: Calendar block contains events from multiple courses
steps: 1. Select a course from the 'All courses' dropdown in the Calendar block

test_cases.test_case: Attempt 'Reset page to default' when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
Dashboard has a custom layout (not default)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate the 'Reset page to default' button in the top-right
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Reset page to default' button is not visible; no reset action can be performed and the dashboard remains in its current customized state (page is unchanged).

test_cases.test_case: Attempt '+ Add a block' when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate and click the '+ Add a block' button below the Dashboard heading
test_cases.expected_result: The '+ Add a block' button is not visible/clickable while Edit mode is OFF; clicking is not possible and the Block Types page is not opened.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open the three-dot menu (Configure/Move/Delete) for a dashboard block when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Dashboard contains at least one dashboard block
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate and click the three-dot menu for any dashboard block
test_cases.expected_result: The three-dot menu control is not visible for dashboard blocks while Edit mode is OFF; Configure/Move/Delete options are not accessible and no block configuration, move, or delete action can be initiated.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to use the Move icon (drag) on a dashboard block when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Dashboard contains at least one dashboard block
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate and drag the Move icon on any dashboard block
test_cases.expected_result: The Move icon is not visible / not interactive while Edit mode is OFF; drag-and-drop cannot be started and the block remains in its current position.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open the Timeline block three-dot menu (Configure/Move/Delete) when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate and click the three-dot menu in the Timeline block
test_cases.expected_result: The three-dot menu control for the Timeline block is not visible while Edit mode is OFF; Configure/Move/Delete actions for the Timeline block are not accessible and no configuration, move, or deletion occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to open the Calendar block three-dot menu (Configure/Move/Delete) when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to locate and click the three-dot menu in the Calendar block
test_cases.expected_result: The three-dot menu control for the Calendar block is not visible while Edit mode is OFF; Configure/Move/Delete actions for the Calendar block are not accessible and no configuration, move, or deletion occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to Delete a dashboard block (three-dot menu) when Edit mode is OFF
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
Dashboard contains at least one dashboard block
Edit_Mode toggle is OFF (Edit mode not active)
steps: 1. Ensure Edit_Mode is OFF
2. Attempt to delete a block by opening its three-dot menu and selecting 'Delete'
test_cases.expected_result: The three-dot menu (and its 'Delete' action) is not visible/accessible while Edit mode is OFF; the delete action cannot be performed and the block remains on the page (no block is removed).

test_cases.test_case: Toggle Edit mode off while a block's three-dot menu is open then attempt Configure
preconditions: User is signed in and on the Dashboard
At least one dashboard block exists
steps: 1. Click the Edit_Mode checkbox to turn Edit mode on
2. Click the three-dot menu (Three_Dot_Menu) for an existing dashboard block to open the menu
3. Immediately click the Edit_Mode checkbox to turn Edit mode off
4. Attempt to click the Configure action in the three-dot menu
test_cases.expected_result: Configure action is blocked: the three-dot menu closes/is no longer visible immediately after Edit mode is toggled off and no configuration modal opens when Configure is clicked; no new configuration UI persists. (Edit mode toggle and menu visibility change succeeds)

test_cases.test_case: Reset page to default after deleting all blocks (empty dashboard)
preconditions: User is signed in and on the Dashboard
There is at least one block on the dashboard
steps: 1. Click the Edit_Mode checkbox to turn Edit mode on
2. For each existing dashboard block, open its Three_Dot_Menu and select Delete until no blocks remain
3. Verify the dashboard shows no blocks (empty)
4. Click the Reset page to default button
test_cases.expected_result: Reset action succeeds: the dashboard is reset to the default layout and default blocks are restored and displayed; a visible indicator or default blocks appear confirming the reset (Reset page to default on_success succeeds)

test_cases.test_case: Timeline Search accepts very long and multi-language input (special characters and emoji)
preconditions: User is signed in and on the Dashboard
steps: 1. Click into the Timeline block Search field
2. Enter a very long string (200+ characters) containing emoji, accented characters, and punctuation into the Search field
3. Press Enter or trigger the search action
test_cases.expected_result: Search accepts the long multi-language input and search executes successfully; the Search input displays the entered string (no silent truncation without indicator). If no activities match, the Timeline shows a visible 'no activities found' / empty state message; no validation error is shown and the search action succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Open a course by clicking its Course Name link
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Click the Course Name link on the card for <course>
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to the Course main page for <course> (navigates to course main page)

test_cases.test_case: Star a course from the card menu and verify it is pinned to the top
preconditions: My Courses page contains visible course card for <course> that is not starred
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the three-dot menu on the card for <course>
3. Click 'Star this course' in the card menu
test_cases.expected_result: The Courses Grid displays the card for <course> at the top of the grid (pins the course to the top); <course> is shown above other courses in the grid

test_cases.test_case: Remove a course from view via card menu and verify it is hidden
preconditions: My Courses page contains visible course card for <course>
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the three-dot menu on the card for <course>
3. Click 'Remove from view' in the card menu
test_cases.expected_result: The course card for <course> is no longer visible in the Courses Grid; this hides the course without unenrolling

test_cases.test_case: Filter My Courses by 'Starred' status shows only starred courses
preconditions: My Courses contains at least one course in Starred state (<starred course>) and at least one course not starred (<other course>)
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the Status filter dropdown
3. Select 'Starred' from the Status filter
test_cases.expected_result: Courses Grid displays only courses that are starred (for example <starred course> is visible) and non-starred courses (for example <other course>) are not visible

test_cases.test_case: Search for a course and verify results are filtered to matches
preconditions: My Courses contains multiple courses including at least one that matches <search term>
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Enter <search term> in the Search field and submit the search
test_cases.expected_result: Courses Grid displays only courses matching <search term>; unrelated courses are no longer visible

test_cases.test_case: Change Layout to Summary and verify the grid updates
steps: 1. Navigate to the My Courses page
2. Open the Layout dropdown
3. Select 'Summary' from the Layout options
test_cases.expected_result: The Courses Grid updates to the Summary layout and course items are displayed in the Summary view

test_cases.test_case: Access My Courses while unauthenticated
preconditions: User is not authenticated / no active session
steps: 1. In a browser session with no user logged in, navigate to <My Courses page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation is blocked: the user is redirected to the login page; the My Courses page is not displayed; a login/sign-in prompt is visible and no course cards or course name links are shown.

test_cases.test_case: Row actions ('Star' / 'Remove from view') not available to non-student role
preconditions: User is logged in as <non-student role> (not a student)
steps: 1. Log in as <non-student role>
2. Navigate to <My Courses page URL>
3. Inspect a course card for the three-dot menu and its menu options
test_cases.expected_result: The three-dot menu is not visible on course cards for this user; the row actions 'Star this course' and 'Remove from view' are not present and cannot be invoked (no menu, no action items).

test_cases.test_case: Search with a very long string ( >200 chars )
preconditions: User is signed in and My Courses page is open
At least one course exists in the Courses_Grid
steps: 1. Focus the Search control
2. Enter <a very long string (200+ characters)> into the Search control
3. Press Enter or click the search/submit control
test_cases.expected_result: Search submits successfully; Courses_Grid updates (may be empty) and the Search control displays the full entered string (no truncation) — UI does not crash and no inline error is shown; overall action succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Search with special characters and emoji
preconditions: User is signed in and My Courses page is open
At least one course exists in the Courses_Grid
steps: 1. Focus the Search control
2. Enter <string containing special characters, punctuation, and emoji> into the Search control
3. Press Enter or click the search/submit control
test_cases.expected_result: Search submits successfully; Courses_Grid updates (may be empty) and the Search control displays the entered characters exactly as typed; no inline validation error is shown and the UI remains responsive; action succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Star a course then immediately Remove from view (rapid consecutive state changes)
preconditions: User is signed in and My Courses page is open
At least one course is visible in the Courses_Grid and is not currently Hidden
steps: 1. Open the three-dot menu for the target course card
2. Click the 'Star this course' action
3. Immediately (without waiting for an explicit page refresh) open the three-dot menu for the same course card
4. Click the 'Remove from view' action
test_cases.expected_result: Remove from view succeeds and the course is removed from the visible Courses_Grid (hidden) with a visible UI indication that it is hidden; the previously applied Star state (pinned to top) no longer appears in the visible grid; no duplicate card remains and no error dialog is shown — final Remove action succeeds

test_cases.test_case: Open course from Course_Name link when filtered to Hidden
preconditions: User is signed in and My Courses page is open
At least one course is currently Hidden (either previously hidden via 'Remove from view' or by data state)
steps: 1. Set the Status_Filter dropdown to 'Hidden'
2. Wait for Courses_Grid to update
3. Click the Course_Name link of a course shown in the Hidden filter results
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation to the course main page succeeds (the app navigates to the course main page) and no error is shown; the click action succeeds while viewing hidden-filtered results

test_cases.test_case: Toggle a section to collapse from expanded state
preconditions: The <target section> is currently expanded and its items are visible
steps: 1. Click the Section_Toggle (chevron) for <target section>
test_cases.expected_result: toggles this section expanded/collapsed — the <target section> is now collapsed: its item list is hidden and the chevron shows the collapsed state

test_cases.test_case: Use 'Collapse all' to collapse every section
preconditions: The course contains multiple sections with at least one section expanded
steps: 1. Click the 'Collapse all' link at the top-right of the course content area
test_cases.expected_result: all sections set to collapsed — each section's item list is hidden and every section's chevron shows the collapsed state

test_cases.test_case: Open an activity/resource from a section
preconditions: A section contains at least one visible item with an Item_Link
steps: 1. Click the Item_Link for <target activity/resource> inside the section
test_cases.expected_result: navigates to activity or resource — the browser navigates to the activity or resource page (the activity/resource page is displayed)

test_cases.test_case: Enable Edit mode as a non-Student user
steps: 1. Click the 'Enable Edit mode' button in the Page Actions area
test_cases.expected_result: enables edit mode for the user — edit controls are visible on the Course page indicating Edit mode is active

test_cases.test_case: Student cannot see 'Enable Edit mode' action (button hidden for Student role)
preconditions: User is logged in with role Student
Course page exists and displays at least one section
steps: 1. Navigate to the Course page for the course
2. Inspect the Page Actions area / action toolbar at the top of the page
test_cases.expected_result: The 'Enable Edit mode' button is not visible in the Page Actions area (no clickable control labeled 'Enable Edit mode'); the page remains in view-only mode and no edit controls are present

test_cases.test_case: Student attempts to trigger Enable Edit mode and is blocked (precondition failure)
preconditions: User is logged in with role Student

steps: 1. While logged in as Student, navigate to the Course page where the 'Enable Edit mode' control is visible

test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked: an authorization error message or inline error indicator is displayed near the action stating the user is not authorized to enable edit mode; Edit mode is not enabled and no edit controls appear on the page (page remains in view-only state)

test_cases.test_case: Rapid consecutive toggle of a single section
preconditions: User is logged in (any role with view access)
A specific section (Section A) is currently expanded and its items are visible
steps: 1. Click the Section_Toggle for Section A
2. Immediately (within 500ms) click the same Section_Toggle for Section A again
test_cases.expected_result: Both toggle actions succeed; the UI reflects the final state dictated by the second click (chevron and items visibility match the last toggle). No error message is shown and the page remains responsive

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Collapse all' when all sections are already collapsed
preconditions: User is logged in (any role with view access)
All course sections are already collapsed
steps: 1. Click the Collapse All link
test_cases.expected_result: Clicking Collapse all succeeds; all sections remain collapsed (no visible state change). No error or warning is shown and no additional UI changes occur

test_cases.test_case: Click 'Collapse all' while multiple sections are expanded
preconditions: User is logged in (any role with view access)
At least two sections are expanded and have visible items
steps: 1. Click the Collapse All link
test_cases.expected_result: Collapse all succeeds; all sections are set to collapsed and their chevrons update to the collapsed state (succeeds). No error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click on an item link (duplicate navigation attempt)
preconditions: User is logged in (any role with view access)
Parent section is expanded and the Item_Link is visible
steps: 1. Click the Item_Link for an activity/resource
2. Immediately (within 300ms) click the same Item_Link again
test_cases.expected_result: First click navigates to the activity/resource; the immediate second click is blocked such that only one navigation occurs (second navigation attempt is blocked). No duplicate pages or duplicate navigations occur and no error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to enable Edit mode as a Student (role boundary)
preconditions: User is logged in with the Student role
steps: 1. Click the Enable Edit mode action in Page_Actions (or attempt to access it if present)
test_cases.expected_result: Action is blocked / error shown: enabling Edit mode is prevented for Student users. The UI either disables or hides the Enable Edit mode control and an inline permission error is shown or no state change occurs (is blocked / error shown)

test_cases.test_case: Enable Edit mode (non-Student) then immediately Collapse all
preconditions: User is logged in with a non-Student role (e.g., Instructor)
At least one section is expanded
steps: 1. Click the Enable Edit mode action
2. Immediately (within 500ms) click the Collapse All link
test_cases.expected_result: Enable Edit mode succeeds; the subsequent Collapse all action also succeeds. Final visible state: Edit mode is enabled for the user and all sections are collapsed (succeeds). No error is shown

test_cases.test_case: Save a very long section name while in Edit mode
preconditions: User is logged in with a non-Student role (e.g., Instructor)
A section exists and its name is editable
steps: 1. Enter a very long string (longer than 200 characters) into the section name field
2. Click the Save/Apply control for the section name change
test_cases.expected_result: Saving the very long section name succeeds; the change is persisted. The section name field in edit mode shows the saved value (succeeds). If the UI truncates display, the full saved value is still visible when re-opening the name editor (succeeds)

test_cases.test_case: Add a new filter condition row
steps: 1. In the Filters area, click '+ Add condition'
test_cases.expected_result: adds a new condition row to Conditions repeating_group

3. Click 'Apply filters'
test_cases.expected_result: applies filter conditions to participants list; Participants table displays only rows matching the specified condition(s)

test_cases.test_case: Clear active filters and restore defaults

steps: 1. Click 'Clear filters' in the Filters area
test_cases.expected_result: resets all filter controls to default; filter controls return to their default state and the Participants table displays the unfiltered list

steps: 1. Click the Match Any checkbox to enable it
test_cases.expected_result: Match Any toggle shows enabled state; When enabled, filter conditions are OR'ed (Any). When disabled, conditions are AND'ed.

test_cases.test_case: Select 'All' in First-name alphabet filter to show all participants
steps: 1. Click 'All' in the First name alphabet filter
test_cases.expected_result: Participants table shows all participants; no first-name initial filter is active

test_cases.test_case: Filter participants by first-name initial 'A'
steps: 1. Click 'A' in the First name alphabet filter
test_cases.expected_result: Participants table displays only rows whose First name begins with 'A'

test_cases.test_case: Select 'All' in Last-name alphabet filter to show all participants

test_cases.test_case: Add an additional activity section then remove it (remove-all repeating-group entries)
preconditions: User is logged in and on the Activities page

steps: 1. Click the 'Add section' control to create a new additional activity section item

test_cases.expected_result: Removal succeeds; no additional activity sections remain on the page; the Activities page continues to display the default sections (Assignments, Forums, Resources) with no error message shown and no leftover UI artifacts from the removed section.

test_cases.test_case: Authenticated user clicks Log out and is returned to the Login page
steps: 1. Locate the 'Log out' button in the application header or account menu
2. Click the 'Log out' button
test_cases.expected_result: Login page is displayed; terminates the current authenticated session and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: After logging out, attempting to open a protected page redirects to the Login page
steps: 1. Click the 'Log out' button
2. Wait until the Login page is displayed
3. Enter the URL of a protected page in the browser address bar (or click a bookmarked protected page) and navigate to it
test_cases.expected_result: Login page is displayed instead of the protected content; access to all protected pages requires re-authentication after logout

test_cases.test_case: Attempt Log out when user is NOT authenticated (precondition failure)
preconditions: User is not authenticated (no active session)
steps: 1. Ensure there is no active authenticated session (e.g. open a new incognito window)
2. Navigate directly to the <logout endpoint/URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation is redirected to the Login page; no logout action is performed on any session (no session termination message); protected pages remain inaccessible without authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Log out control is not visible to unauthenticated users
steps: 1. Ensure there is no active authenticated session
2. Open the application main page / header where authentication controls are shown
test_cases.expected_result: The Log out / "Log out" button is not visible in the UI for unauthenticated users; only authentication entry controls (e.g., Login) are shown. Attempting to locate or click a non-present Log out control is not possible.

test_cases.test_case: After clicking Log out, access to a protected page is blocked (postcondition enforcement)
steps: 1. Authenticate as <role>
2. Click the Log out button
3. After logout completes, navigate to a known <protected page URL>
test_cases.expected_result: Navigation to the <protected page URL> is redirected to the Login page; protected page content is not displayed and the user remains unauthenticated (no session restored).

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click on Log out button
preconditions: User is authenticated and viewing a protected page with the Log out button visible
steps: 1. Click the Log out button once
2. Immediately (before the UI completes navigation) click the Log out button a second time
test_cases.expected_result: First logout attempt succeeds: user is redirected to the login page and the authenticated session is terminated. The second immediate click is ignored (no additional session creation or errors); no visible error message is shown and only one redirect to the login page occurs.

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab, then reload or navigate to protected page in another tab
preconditions: User is authenticated and has two browser tabs open on protected pages (Tab A and Tab B)
steps: 1. In Tab A, click the Log out button
2. In Tab B, reload a protected page or navigate to another protected route
test_cases.expected_result: Access to the protected page in Tab B is blocked: the user is redirected to the login page or shown an authentication prompt; protected content must not be displayed without re-authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Use browser Back after logout (cached protected page scenario)
preconditions: User is authenticated and viewing a protected page
steps: 1. Click the Log out button
2. After redirect to the login page completes, press the browser Back button
test_cases.expected_result: Access is blocked: pressing Back must not grant authenticated access. Either the app redirects back to the login page immediately, or a cached view appears but any interaction with that view immediately redirects to login / shows authentication required. Protected actions remain unavailable without re-authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Click Log out when the UI shows authenticated but the server-side session has already expired
preconditions: User session has expired on the server side but the client UI still displays as authenticated (simulate by waiting for session expiry or invalidating server session)
steps: 1. Click the Log out button
test_cases.expected_result: Logout action succeeds idempotently: the user is redirected to the login page and no error is shown. The system remains in an unauthenticated state and no additional errors or duplicate session termination messages are displayed.
